#### 1. hypoalphalipoproteinemia, primary, 1  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.735)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-8963896, Reactome:R-HSA-9029569, Reactome:R-HSA-1989781, Reactome:R-HSA-5682113)

**How to falsify it:** Identification of a pathogenic gain-of-function variant in ABCA1 that causes either Tangier disease or hypoalphalipoproteinemia, primary, 1, or the absence of hypocholesterolemia in individuals with ABCA1 loss-of-function variants. _(variant: rs1800960)_
